added.title: Memories of Bobby
added.description: When a pillar of the Creek community leaves, our trio mourns their loss by remembering the good times.

added.title: Jacob of the Creek
added.description: A terrible haircut forces Craig to go undercover at the Creek.

added.title: Return of the Honeysuckle Rangers
added.description: Craig discovers that the Honeysuckle Rangers have snuck into his side of the Creek to steal his most prized possession.

added.title: Kelsey the Elder
added.description: A spat between the Elders of the Creek leaves an opening in their tabletop role playing game, so Kelsey joins the campaign!

added.title: Sour Candy Trials
added.description: Craig goes on a mind-bending journey as he tries to eat the most sour candy in the Creek!

added.title: Fort Williams
added.description: When Craig can't go to the Creek, he and his mom decide to build the biggest blanket fort in the world!

added.title: The Other Side
added.description: Craig, Kelsey and JP must journey past the Overpass into uncharted territory, the Other Side of the Creek.

added.title: Summer Wish
added.description: When Craig decides to keep a lightning bug in a jar, he disrupts the delicate balance of Summer.

added.title: Turning the Tables
added.description: Craig dines at the restaurant where his older brother works and orders up a plate of REVENGE... and lots of breadsticks.

added.title: Alone Quest
added.description: Craig has an "emergency" leaving Kelsey alone at the Stump.

added.title: The Duel
added.description: Iyanu faces off against Adura, Queen of the Deep, in a fierce battle. What starts as a seesaw struggle becomes a desperate fight for Iyanu. Meanwhile, in Elu, Kanfo sends Teju and Siju on a mission to confirm if the People of the Deep are invading.

added.title: The Conduit
added.description: After Boju destroys The Conduit, Iyanu's spirit form is propelled through a tunnel of light to a mysterious location where she meets a familiar face. Back in Yorubaland, the countdown to the release of The Fallen One begins.

added.title: Whatever Happened to Babsy Bunny?
added.description: Babs is drawn into the world of modeling by animal calendar photographer, Elmyra Duff, while Plucky grapples with a bad caricature.

added.title: Prank You Very Much
added.description: It's Prank Week at Acme Loo and our pals get into escalating shenanigans trying to out prank their rival, Aqua Loo.

added.title: TP2: Judgement Bidet
added.description: When the city experiences a toilet paper shortage Beth and Harold investigate and discover it's their old rival Sewer Mike who is the mastermind behind it all.

added.title: A Dingo Ate My Duncan
added.description: When all their classmates are replaced with well behaved Australian doppelgangers in a school exchange program, Lightning and Cody start getting suspicious.

added.title: The Brain of Evil
added.description: Mordecai and Rigby have to recapture something they lost.

added.title: Fries Night
added.description: Benson wants some french fries to overcome his depression.

added.title: Spacey McSpaceTree
added.description: Rigby has to pass a safety test.

added.title: Can You Ear Me Now?
added.description: Mordecai and Rigby offend some people.

added.title: Stuck in an Elevator
added.description: Mordecai and Rigby want to go to a reunion concert.

added.title: The Space Race
added.description: The guys race in space.

added.title: Operation: Hear No Evil
added.description: Mordecai and Rigby want to avoid spoilers of their favorite TV show.

added.title: Space Escape
added.description: The guys have to escape from someone bad.

added.title: New Beds
added.description: The guys get new beds.

added.title: Mordeby and Rigbecai
added.description: Mordecai and Rigby mess around with a teleportation machine, and you can pretty much imagine how this one goes.

added.title: Nature Chat
added.description: During a picnic in the park, Mel isn't being considerate of the environment around her. Barney transforms the kids into butterflies who can talk to the plants and animals. Mel learns it's important to respect and be a caretaker of nature.

added.title: Ace in the Hole
added.description: When a group of alley dogs, aided by a heroic stray, are saved from Catwoman by kind-hearted Buff, he brings them all back to live in the Batcave, unbeknownst to the rest of the Bat-Family.

added.title: Balloon Voyage
added.description: The Looney Builders are hired by Mac Gopher to build a hot air balloon for him and Tosh to ride in for a festival. Tosh keeps his fear of flying to himself and tries to weigh down the build to avoid liftoff.

added.title: Yosemite Sam's Dude Ranch
added.description: The Looney Builders are hired by Yosemite Sam to build a dude ranch. Sam hurries the crew along, negatively impacting their work.

added.title: Once Upon a Rainbow
added.description: When Grumpy mysteriously loses his blue color in a far-off area of the Silver Lining, the Bears track down the cause: a creature called the Painter has lost the key to the magical paintbox that creates all the color in the area. Grumpy must recover the key to restore his blueness.

added.title: Missing Mel
added.description: Mel breaks her arm and is away from the park while she gets a cast. David really misses her, so Barney creates magical games to help David and Vivie do something nice for Mel for when she gets back.

added.title: When You're A Jet
added.description: Green Arrow and his Arrowplane, Goldie, come to help Batman take on the Riddler. Batwing is so happy to have another flying vehicle around that she brings Goldie to life and the two become BFFs. But when Goldie eventually has to leave, Batwing learns that saying goodbye doesn't always mean forever!

added.title: Road Trip
added.description: On a mission to a remote area of the Silver Lining, Cheer questions the directions from Bedtime's maps. Everyone else backs Bedtime: he's never been wrong before! When the directions turn out to be wrong and lead them into danger, Cheer must trust her instincts to find a way out of the mess.
